description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyInstrumentationEvent class, which extends MonkeyEvent and facilitates injecting instrumentation events in the Android Monkey testing framework. It includes fields for test case and runner names, and a method to inject events by invoking startInstrumentation on the IActivityManager interface.

classes.name: MonkeyInstrumentationEvent
classes.description: Represents an instrumentation event for the Android Monkey testing framework, allowing tests to be started programmatically with specified test case and runner names.

methods.name: MonkeyInstrumentationEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a test case name and runner name, and sets the event type.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the instrumentation event by calling startInstrumentation on the IActivityManager. Throws an exception if the component name is invalid or if there is a remote exception.
